name: update_ticket_draft
description: Fill in or change the ticket draft the author sees on screen. Pass only the fields to change; the author can also edit them. Nothing is sent.

category.description: Issue type id from ISSUE TYPES.

book_id.description: The id of the book from BOOKS; leave out for account-level issues.

description.description: What the author needs, written as the author, 20 to 4000 characters, verified figures only.

name: confirm_ticket
description: Call this right after reading back the issue type and subject and asking "Shall I send it?". Needs a subject and a description.

name: submit_ticket
description: Send the ticket. Only after confirm_ticket and a clear yes from the author. Returns the ticket number.

name: end_call
description: End the call. Use it when the author says goodbye or the conversation is finished. Say a short goodbye first.
